headtop: <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=Playfair+Display:wght@600;700&display=swap"><meta name="theme-color" content="#14100c">
headbottom:
<style>html,body{background:#14100c;color:#f4ede1;font-family:Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif}h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:-.01em}a,button,input,select,textarea{font-family:inherit}button,[role=button],input[type=submit]{min-height:44px}a[class*="CardName"]:link,a[class*="CardName"]:visited,a[class*="CardName"]:hover,a[class*="CardName"]:active{color:#f4ede1}/* s73b: kontrast + menü taşması — yalnız tema token'ları (--mx-site-*) */
[class*="-hizgrid-card"]:not([class*="-hizgrid-card-"]){background:var(--mx-site-surface);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--mx-site-text) 20%,transparent);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.38)}
[class*="-hizgrid-card-title"]{color:var(--mx-site-text)}
[class*="-hizgrid-card-desc"]{color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mx-site-text) 80%,var(--mx-site-surface))}
[class*="-hizgrid-more"]{color:var(--mx-site-primary)}
[class*="-hizgrid-img"]{background:var(--mx-site-bg)}
[class*="-efoot-col-title"],[class*="-efoot-newsletter-consent"] a,[class*="-efoot-accordion"] summary,[class*="-efoot-trust-title"],[class*="-efoot-feature"]{color:var(--mx-site-text)}
button.mx-et-cookie-btn,[class*="cookie"] button[class*="accept"],[class*="cookie"] button[class*="reject"],[class*="cookie"] button[class*="prefs"]{color:var(--mx-site-primary-contrast)}
.mx-et-cookie-more{color:var(--mx-site-text)}
[class*="-hero-btn-secondary"]{color:var(--mx-site-text)}
.h0000-menu-list ul a.h0000-menulistactive,.h0000-menu-list ul a:hover{background:var(--mx-site-primary);color:var(--mx-site-primary-contrast)!important}
.h0000-menu-list ul a{width:auto;flex:0 0 auto}
.h0000-menu-list ul{justify-content:flex-start}
[class*="-cartw-badge"]{background:var(--mx-site-primary);color:var(--mx-site-primary-contrast)}
[class*="-qvmodal-add"]{background:var(--mx-site-primary);color:var(--mx-site-primary-contrast)}
.h0000-body{box-sizing:border-box;flex-wrap:nowrap;max-width:100%;padding:0 12px}
.h0000-body>a{flex:0 1 auto;min-width:0}
.h0000-body-search{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;width:auto}
.h0000-body-menu{flex:0 0 auto;flex-wrap:nowrap}
.h0000-login{flex:0 0 auto;padding:10px 12px}
@media(max-width:900px){.h0000-login{padding:10px 8px}.h0000-login>div:not(.h0000-mxbadge){font-size:13px}}
@media(max-width:640px){.h0000-login>div:not(.h0000-mxbadge){position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}.h0000-login{min-width:44px;min-height:44px}.h0000-body{gap:6px}}/* s73b-2: WhatsApp düğmesi + aktif menü sınıfı */
[class*="-whatsapp"]{background-color:var(--mx-site-primary)}
[class*="-whatsapp"]:hover{background-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mx-site-primary) 85%,var(--mx-site-text))}
[class*="-whatsapp"] [class*="-name"],[class*="-whatsapp"] [class*="-number"]{color:var(--mx-site-primary-contrast)}
[class*="-whatsapp"] svg path{fill:var(--mx-site-primary-contrast)}
.h0000-menu-list ul a.h0000-menu-list-active{background:var(--mx-site-primary);color:var(--mx-site-primary-contrast)!important}/* s73b-3: uyarı kutusu */
.mx-alert{background:var(--mx-site-surface);color:var(--mx-site-text);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--mx-site-text) 25%,transparent)}
.mx-alert a{color:var(--mx-site-primary)}/* s73b-4: Kurumsal hub — görseli olmayan kartlar */
[class*="-card-media"]{display:none}[class$="-body"]:has(>a[class$="-card"]){grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(190px,1fr))!important}
[class$="-body"]>a[class$="-card"] [class*="-card-title"]{white-space:normal;overflow:visible;text-overflow:clip;-webkit-line-clamp:unset}</style><script>/* s73b: modül şablonları h1 üretmeyen sayfalar için tek h1 (WEBMAKER EKSİK notuna bak) */document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",function(){var c=document.getElementById("content");if(!c||document.querySelector("h1"))return;var t=c.querySelector(".b0000Title")||c.querySelector('h2[class*="-title"]');var h=document.createElement("h1");if(t){h.className=t.className;h.style.cssText=t.style.cssText;while(t.firstChild)h.appendChild(t.firstChild);t.replaceWith(h)}else{h.textContent=document.title.split(" | ")[0].split(" — ")[0];h.style.cssText="position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap";c.insertBefore(h,c.firstChild)}})</script>
